column1: Required Skills for All Roles in the Biotech Career PDF
Biotechnology Roles
Immunology Scientist: Immunology assays, ELISA, flow cytometry, antibody engineering, cell culture, data analysis
Genetics Scientist: Genomics, CRISPR, PCR/qPCR, DNA sequencing, bioinformatics basics, statistical genetics
Molecular Biologist: PCR, cloning, gel electrophoresis, gene expression analysis, sequencing
Research Scientist: Experimental design, data analysis, scientific writing, literature review, project management
Protein Scientist: Protein purification, chromatography, western blotting, protein characterization
Cell Culture Scientist: Mammalian cell culture, aseptic techniques, media prep, microscopy
Bioprocess Engineer: Bioreactors, fermentation technology, downstream processing, GMP
Fermentation Engineer: Microbial fermentation, scale■up techniques, bioreactor control
Process Development Engineer: Process optimization, scale■up, statistical process control
QC Analyst: HPLC/GC, analytical testing, GMP/GLP documentation
Production Scientist: Biomanufacturing, batch production, process monitoring
QA Specialist: Quality management systems, audits, regulatory compliance
Bioinformatics Roles
Genomics Scientist: NGS analysis, genome assembly, variant analysis, Python/R
Computational Biologist: Programming, sequence analysis, statistics, structural bioinformatics
AI Genomics Scientist: Machine learning, deep learning, genomics datasets, Python
Systems Biology Scientist: Biological network modeling, omics integration, statistics
Life Sciences Consultant: Scientific knowledge, market analysis, communication, regulatory understanding
Healthcare Data Analyst: SQL, Python/R, healthcare data analysis, visualization
Bioinformatics Analyst: BLAST, genome annotation, scripting (Python/R), databases
Bioinformatics Engineer: Pipeline development, cloud computing, software development
Genomics Data Scientist: Machine learning, large biological datasets, statistics
Chemical Roles
Process Chemistry Researcher: Chemical synthesis, reaction optimization, analytical chemistry
Material Scientist: Material characterization, spectroscopy, microscopy
Polymer Scientist: Polymer synthesis, rheology, polymer testing
Chemical Scientist: Spectroscopy, chromatography, reaction design
Catalysis Scientist: Catalyst design, reaction kinetics, surface chemistry
Production Engineer: Manufacturing processes, plant operations, safety standards
Plant Engineer: Plant maintenance, process control systems, equipment management
Petrochemical Engineer: Refining processes, thermodynamics, reaction engineering
Process Safety Engineer: Hazard analysis, safety regulations, risk assessment
Process Engineer: Process design, simulation tools, optimization
Bioengineering / Nanotechnology Roles
Nanomedicine Scientist: Nanoparticle drug delivery, biomaterials, cell studies
Biomedical Materials Scientist: Biomaterials design, tissue engineering basics
Nano Materials Scientist: Nanomaterial synthesis, SEM/TEM microscopy
Nanotech Scientist: Nanofabrication, nanodevice design
Nanoelectronics Researcher: Nanoelectronics, semiconductor physics
Biomedical Product Engineer: Medical device design, prototyping, regulatory standards
Biomedical Engineer: Biomedical instrumentation, biomechanics
Device Development Engineer: Product development, testing, regulatory compliance
Medical Device Engineer: CAD design, validation testing, FDA/GMP standards
Biomedical Systems Engineer: Systems modeling, biomedical instrumentation
Chemistry Roles
Pharmaceutical Chemist: Drug formulation, medicinal chemistry, regulatory knowledge
Analytical Research Chemist: HPLC, GC■MS, spectroscopy, method validation
Research Chemist: Chemical synthesis, lab research, data interpretation
Organic Chemist: Organic synthesis, reaction mechanisms, NMR/IR spectroscopy
Medicinal Chemist: Drug design, SAR studies, pharmacology basics
QC Chemist: Quality testing, analytical chemistry, GMP documentation
Analytical Chemist: Instrumental analysis, chromatography, spectroscopy
Process Chemist: Chemical scale■up, reaction optimization
Formulation Chemist: Drug formulation, stability studies, excipient compatibility
